adjustments.reason: The Living Thread's measured attach range is 4.0 u, not 9. From the launch shelf's edge (Qori's centre at 6.6, 4.6) the anchor at (9, 8) is 4.16 u away and can't be cast to; at (9, 7.2) it is 3.54 u. It stays above the catch floor with the same swing line.

The baffle's foot left 1.0 u over the low walk (top 2) for a 1.2 u body, so the designed lower return (29,2 -> 17,2 -> 3,2) was impassable. Raised to the package's 2.4 u headroom minimum; its top (11) and the upper loop are unchanged.

The live movement has no drop-through: one-way decks only let Qori up. East_mid ran wall to baffle, so after the Root latch (28, 10) there was no way down to the exit (29, 2). A 2 u gap at its west end lets him drop to east_low; the latch, E2 under it and the climb back up are unchanged.
Same cause: a 2 u gap at its east end lets Qori drop to the low walk beside the exit, so the designed zigzag descent (28,10 -> 25.5,8 -> 28,6 -> 29,2) works as walk-off drops.

Thread range 4.0 u: from a top-4 deck (Qori's centre 4.6 u) the anchor at height 9 is 4.4 u away and can't be cast to standing; at 8.4 it is 3.8 u. From the top-6 decks it stays above the 0.8 u minimum length.
